verdict.rationale: Asking an AI questions about workspace content is a fair axis for a work-management product like Trello, but the pack has no first-party AI Q&A with citations. 'Use AI to help write or edit content' is a writing aid, not question answering. The MCP server only lets external AI tools connect to Trello, which is an integration building block rather than the product answering questions itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask AI a question and get an instant answer with citations from my workspace content
